query:
SELECT r.id, r.next_run_at
            FROM reminder r
            WHERE r.enabled
              AND r.completed_at IS NULL
              AND r.cron IS NULL
              AND r.next_run_at <= $1
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM reminder_occurrence o
                  WHERE o.reminder_id = r.id
                    AND o.scheduled_for = r.next_run_at
                    AND o.sent_at IS NOT NULL
              )
            ORDER BY r.next_run_at
